public_definitions: Review the weekend pop-up Units Sold by Product dashboard, then complete the Product C merchandising review intake by selecting the appropriate product route.
Use the Units Sold by Product dashboard as the evidence source for the Product C merchandising route.

Merchandising route rule: < 12,000 units → Critical low-demand escalation level; < 25,000 units → Low-demand review queue activation level; < 2,500 units from a decision threshold → Manual merchandising verification variance band; >= 50,000 units → Expanded replenishment planning level; >= 75,000 units → Growth allocation review level.
